headline: Garmin’s new Fenix 9 adds brighter screens and smoother map panning
summary: Garmin unveils its rugged Fenix 9 smartwatches with OLED displays. The Fenix 9 features up to 3,000 nits brightness and 50% more RAM. Base model starts at $999.99 for the 43mm version.

headline: Trump is upping the price of Big Tech’s favorite visa
summary: DHS announced a new fee exceeding $103,000 for H-1B visas. The State Department plans to revoke up to 200,000 asylum seeker visas. These policy changes significantly impact legal immigration.

headline: At just $8, you owe it to yourself to grab Inscryption
summary: Daniel Mullins' critically acclaimed game Inscryption is on sale for just $8. The deal is available via Humble for the Steam version. Experience the unique deckbuilder from the creator of Pony Island.

headline: The Witcher 3 is getting a remaster
summary: CD Projekt Red is remastering The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. The updated RPG launches September 29th with visual and combat improvements. It also includes a reimagined skill tree and the first two expansions.

headline: Atari Is Re-Releasing 39 Atari 2600 Games on Working, Physical Cartridges
summary: Atari and Activision collaborate on the new Atari x Activision Collection. 39 classic Atari 2600 games are being re-released. Games will be available on working, physical cartridges.

headline: Heroes of Might and Magic 3 Remake Preview: Hands-On with Ubisoft’s Reborn Strategy Classic - Gamescom 2026
summary: Ubisoft is remaking the classic strategy game Heroes of Might and Magic 3. The 1999 title is being revived for both PC and consoles. IGN got an exclusive hands-on preview at Gamescom 2026.

headline: Wilderings: The Lost Spring Gameplay Trailer Reveals Volcanic Biome, a Moth Boss, and a Version 1.0 Release Window
summary: Wilderings: The Lost Spring unveils a new gameplay trailer. The trailer showcases a volcanic biome and a unique moth boss. A version 1.0 release window for the game was also announced.

headline: Metro 2039 Developers on How Russia's Invasion of Ukraine Changed Their Plans
summary: Developers of Metro 2039 discussed impacts of Russia's invasion of Ukraine. The war significantly altered plans for the upcoming FPS sequel. Ukrainian developer 4A Games continues work amidst real-world challenges.

headline: Iconic country singer Dolly Parton dies at 80
summary: Iconic country musician Dolly Parton has passed away at the age of 80. Her team announced the news on social media. She leaves behind a lasting legacy as a beloved country star.

headline: Household energy bills to hit three-year high as Ofgem announces 4% rise from October
summary: Ofgem announces a 4% rise in household energy bills from October. Typical households will pay an extra £60 a year. This marks a three-year high for energy costs.

headline: Dad of woman who took her own life says Treasury failed in its duty of care
summary: A father alleges the Treasury failed its duty of care for his late daughter. Chloe Moffat died after allegations of sharing sensitive information, which she denied. The case raises concerns about employee welfare in government departments.

headline: Yellow warnings in force as rain and thunderstorms hit parts of UK
summary: Yellow weather warnings are active for rain and thunderstorms across parts of the UK. Parts of England and Wales face torrential downpours. Expect some of the wettest weather in several weeks.
